title.zh: 设置存储空间的授权策略

descriptions.zh:
- 向其他账号的RAM用户授权访问。

您可以授予其他账号的RAM用户访问您的OSS资源的权限。

- 向匿名用户授予带特定IP条件限制的访问权限。

某些场景下，您需要向匿名用户授予带IP限制的访问策略。例如，企业内部的机密文档，只允许在企业内部访问，不允许在其他区域访问。由于企业内部人员较多，如果针对每个人配置RAM Policy，工作量非常大。此时，您可以基于Bucket Policy设置带IP限制的访问策略，从而高效方便地进行授权。

有关Bucket Policy的配置详情及场景案例，请参见[使用Bucket Policy授权其他用户访问OSS资源](~~85111~~)。有关Policy语法，请参见[权限策略语法和结构](~~93739~~)。
descriptions.en:
- Grant access permissions to Resource Access Management (RAM) users of other accounts.

You can grant RAM users of other accounts access permissions to your OSS resources.

- Grant access permissions to anonymous users with IP address-based restrictions.

In some scenarios, you need to grant anonymous users an access policy with IP address restrictions. For example, confidential documents within an enterprise are allowed to be accessed only from within the enterprise network and not from other areas. Because the enterprise has a large number of internal users, configuring a RAM policy for each user requires significant effort. In this case, you can configure a bucket policy with IP address restrictions to efficiently perform authorization.

For details about bucket policy configurations and scenario examples, see [Use bucket policies to authorize other users to access OSS resources](~~85111~~). For details about the policy syntax, see [Access policy syntax and structure](~~93739~~).
